highlights: Working on assessing and improving the robustness of NLP systems.

Built adversarial evaluation frameworks to identify vulnerabilities in LLMs under Unicode-based stylistic and linguistic perturbations, uncovering systematic robustness failures across diverse subpopulations.
Developed interpretability-based methods to enhance the robustness of LLMs.
Designed red-teaming benchmark to evaluate safety robustness of open-source LLMs across multiple languages.

projects.name: Sentiment, Emotion, Sarcasm & Hate speech Classifier
projects.summary: This project is done in collaboration with CENTRE FOR DEVELOPMENT OF TELEMATICS (CDOT) Delhi. We developed a multilingual surveillance system capable of analyzing sentiment, emotion for English and Hindi languages, Sarcasm and Hate speech detection for English.

projects.name: Information Diffusion in Online Social Networks
projects.summary: This project is implemented with deep learning approach in python language as a part of M.Tech thesis which predicts how far a piece of information will travel in the online social network.
